d: Jensen Huang may have stepped down as Nvidia CEO, but the spotlight has now shifted to his daughter, Madison Huang. Officially a senior director of product marketing for physical AI, she reportedly wielded influence far beyond her designation, acting as her father's de facto chief of staff and holding sway over senior executives. A reported clash with Indian-origin Nvidia veteran Jay Puri over preparations for an event in New Delhi has brought her management style into focus. We look at who Madison Huang is, how she gained influence inside Nvidia and why her role is now raising questions…
